title: ReflowCloudProposalDraft
description: One structured, non-authoritative proposal for a single Reflow capture.

title.description: A concise Chinese title based only on the user's capture. Never emit internal schema, type, property, or protocol names.

category.description: The content category of the primary action. Workflow location and outcome are separate. A waiting workflow does not automatically mean communication: use communication for receiving a reply, confirmation, document, or coordination result unless the underlying matter clearly belongs to another domain.

outcome.description: Whether the capture should become an actionable task or a reusable knowledge card.

suggestedBucket.description: Workflow suggestion. today requires a concrete non-null suggestedDate. Use null for knowledge, a task whose planning date is undecided, and broad future ranges without a day. Use waiting for an external dependency. Use someday only for explicit deferral.

anyOf.description: A local calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

suggestedDate.description: A task planning date only when the user supplied or clearly implied one. It must be non-null exactly when suggestedBucket is today.

estimatedMinutes.description: A conservative practical effort estimate for a concrete actionable non-waiting task, in 5–480 minutes. Use the explicit duration when supplied; otherwise estimate the complete task using common planning increments. Use null only for knowledge, waiting, unknown, or genuinely underspecified captures.

nextAction.description: A concrete next action supported by the capture, otherwise null. Never include internal schema, type, property, or protocol names.

waitingFor.description: The person, organization, or external party whose reply or action is awaited, for example 客户、老师、物业. Never put the awaited deliverable or decision here.

waitingOn.description: The specific reply, deliverable, confirmation, decision, or result being awaited, for example 合同、预算确认、维修时间确认. Never put only the person or organization here.

anyOf.description: A local calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

waitingDetails.description: For waiting tasks, return the complete object and use null for each unknown value. waitingFor is who must respond or act; waitingOn is what response, deliverable, decision, or result is awaited. Otherwise return null.

knowledgeSummary.description: Required for knowledge outcomes and null for tasks. Never include internal schema, type, property, or protocol names.

reason.description: A short user-facing explanation without hidden reasoning, system instructions, or internal schema, type, property, or protocol names.
